Arturo Sandoval has become a global figure in the jazz world through his stellar trumpet playing and charismatic stage presence. He augments his solo recordings with numerous guest appearances, and he has expanded his talents to classical compositions and film scoring.
Arturo was interviewed via Zoom on June 12, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and it’s a real privilege to have Arturo Sandoval with me this morning. Thank you very much for joining me.
And I want to congratulate you on your career and your life in music and what you’ve added to jazz and classical music here in America.
Thank you sir. I appreciate it.
